nodes.name: nodes
nodes.description: Total number of nodes in the network graph.

edges.name: edges
edges.description: Total number of edges connections between nodes.

components.name: components
components.description: Number of connected components in the network graph.

density.name: density
density.description: Network density measures how many edges are present compared to the maximum possible edges. Values range from 0 to 1. Reference: https://networkx.org/documentation/stable/reference/generated/networkx.classes.function.density.html

bridges.name: bridges
bridges.description: Number of bridges in the network graph. A bridge is an edge whose removal increases the number of connected components. Reference: https://networkx.org/documentation/stable/reference/algorithms/generated/networkx.algorithms.bridges.html

diameter.name: diameter
diameter.description: The longest shortest path between any two nodes in the network. This measures the maximum distance in the network. Details at https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Diameter_(graph_theory)

transitivity.name: transitivity
transitivity.description: Global clustering coefficient measuring the probability that adjacent nodes are connected. See https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Clustering_coefficient for more information

average_clustering.name: average_clustering
average_clustering.description: Average clustering coefficient across all nodes in the network. This indicates the tendency of nodes to form clusters. Reference: https://networkx.org/documentation/stable/reference/algorithms/generated/networkx.algorithms.cluster.average_clustering.html

degree_assortativity.name: degree_assortativity
degree_assortativity.description: The degree assortativity measures the correlation between nodes of similar degrees. A positive value indicates that nodes tend to connect to nodes with similar degrees, while a negative value indicates that nodes tend to connect to nodes with different degrees. Reference: https://networkx.org/documentation/stable/reference/algorithms/generated/networkx.algorithms.assortativity.degree_assortativity_coefficient.html

label_communities.name: label_communities
label_communities.description: Number of communities detected using the label propagation algorithm. Reference: https://networkx.org/documentation/stable/reference/algorithms/generated/networkx.algorithms.community.label_propagation.label_communities.html

lpa_communities.name: lpa_communities
lpa_communities.description: Number of communities detected using the label propagation algorithm. Reference: https://networkx.org/documentation/stable/reference/algorithms/generated/networkx.algorithms.community.label_propagation.lpa_communities.html

label_non_randomness.name: label_non_randomness
label_non_randomness.description: Non-randomness measure for label propagation communities. Reference: https://networkx.org/documentation/stable/reference/algorithms/generated/networkx.algorithms.community.label_propagation.label_non_randomness.html

lpa_non_randomness.name: lpa_non_randomness
lpa_non_randomness.description: Non-randomness measure for label propagation communities. Reference: https://networkx.org/documentation/stable/reference/algorithms/generated/networkx.algorithms.community.label_propagation.lpa_non_randomness.html

label_relative_non_randomness.name: label_relative_non_randomness
label_relative_non_randomness.description: Relative non-randomness measure for label propagation communities. Reference: https://networkx.org/documentation/stable/reference/algorithms/generated/networkx.algorithms.community.label_propagation.label_relative_non_randomness.html

lpa_relative_non_randomness.name: lpa_relative_non_randomness
lpa_relative_non_randomness.description: Relative non-randomness measure for label propagation communities. Reference: https://networkx.org/documentation/stable/reference/algorithms/generated/networkx.algorithms.community.label_propagation.lpa_relative_non_randomness.html

average_node_connectivity.name: average_node_connectivity
average_node_connectivity.description: Average node connectivity across all nodes in the network. This measures the minimum number of edges that must be removed to disconnect any pair of nodes. Reference: https://networkx.org/documentation/stable/reference/algorithms/generated/networkx.algorithms.connectivity.average_node_connectivity.html

burt_effective_size.name: burt_effective_size
burt_effective_size.description: Effective size of nodes in the network according to Burt's measure. Reference: https://networkx.org/documentation/stable/reference/algorithms/generated/networkx.algorithms.centrality.burt_effective_size.html

closeness_vitality.name: closeness_vitality
closeness_vitality.description: Closeness vitality of nodes in the network. Reference: https://networkx.org/documentation/stable/reference/algorithms/generated/networkx.algorithms.centrality.closeness_vitality.html

common_neighbor_centrality.name: common_neighbor_centrality
common_neighbor_centrality.description: Common neighbor centrality of nodes in the network. Reference: https://networkx.org/documentation/stable/reference/algorithms/generated/networkx.algorithms.centrality.common_neighbor_centrality.html

communicability_betweenness_centrality.name: communicability_betweenness_centrality
communicability_betweenness_centrality.description: Communicability betweenness centrality of nodes in the network. Reference: https://networkx.org/documentation/stable/reference/algorithms/generated/networkx.algorithms.centrality.communicability_betweenness_centrality.html

constraint.name: constraint
constraint.description: Constraint of nodes in the network. Reference: https://networkx.org/documentation/stable/reference/algorithms/generated/networkx.algorithms.centrality.constraint.html

degree_dist_entropy.name: degree_dist_entropy
degree_dist_entropy.description: Entropy of the degree distribution in the network. Reference: https://networkx.org/documentation/stable/reference/algorithms/generated/networkx.algorithms.entropy.degree_dist_entropy.html

degree_dist_entropy_norm.name: degree_dist_entropy_norm
degree_dist_entropy_norm.description: Normalized entropy of the degree distribution in the network. Reference: https://networkx.org/documentation/stable/reference/algorithms/generated/networkx.algorithms.entropy.degree_dist_entropy_norm.html

effective_size.name: effective_size
effective_size.description: Effective size of nodes in the network. Reference: https://networkx.org/documentation/stable/reference/algorithms/generated/networkx.algorithms.centrality.effective_size.html

nodes_intersect_rate.name: nodes_intersect_rate
nodes_intersect_rate.description: Rate of intersection of nodes in the network. Reference: https://networkx.org/documentation/stable/reference/algorithms/generated/networkx.algorithms.intersection.nodes_intersect_rate.html

edges_intersect_rate.name: edges_intersect_rate
edges_intersect_rate.description: Rate of intersection of edges in the network. Reference: https://networkx.org/documentation/stable/reference/algorithms/generated/networkx.algorithms.intersection.edges_intersect_rate.html

sampled_nodes_intersect_rate_mean.name: sampled_nodes_intersect_rate_mean
sampled_nodes_intersect_rate_mean.description: Mean of sampled nodes intersection rate in the network.

sampled_edges_intersect_rate_mean.name: sampled_edges_intersect_rate_mean
sampled_edges_intersect_rate_mean.description: Mean of sampled edges intersection rate in the network.

sampled_nodes_intersect_rate_std.name: sampled_nodes_intersect_rate_std
sampled_nodes_intersect_rate_std.description: Standard deviation of sampled nodes intersection rate in the network.

sampled_edges_intersect_rate_std.name: sampled_edges_intersect_rate_std
sampled_edges_intersect_rate_std.description: Standard deviation of sampled edges intersection rate in the network.

gini_betweenness_centrality.name: gini_betweenness_centrality
gini_betweenness_centrality.description: Gini coefficient of betweenness centrality in the network. Reference: https://networkx.org/documentation/stable/reference/algorithms/generated/networkx.algorithms.centrality.gini_betweenness_centrality.html

global_efficiency.name: global_efficiency
global_efficiency.description: Global efficiency of the network. Reference: https://networkx.org/documentation/stable/reference/algorithms/generated/networkx.algorithms.efficiency.global_efficiency.html

information_centrality.name: information_centrality
information_centrality.description: Information centrality of nodes in the network. Reference: https://networkx.org/documentation/stable/reference/algorithms/generated/networkx.algorithms.centrality.information_centrality.html

jaccard_coefficient.name: jaccard_coefficient
jaccard_coefficient.description: Jaccard coefficient of nodes in the network. Reference: https://networkx.org/documentation/stable/reference/algorithms/generated/networkx.algorithms.similarity.jaccard_coefficient.html

wasserstein_distance.name: wasserstein_distance
wasserstein_distance.description: Wasserstein distance between degree distributions of the network. Reference: https://networkx.org/documentation/stable/reference/algorithms/generated/networkx.algorithms.wasserstein_distance.html

mean_betweenness_centrality.name: mean_betweenness_centrality
mean_betweenness_centrality.description: Mean betweenness centrality of nodes in the network.

mean_degree.name: mean_degree
mean_degree.description: Mean degree of nodes in the network.

min_edge_cover.name: min_edge_cover
min_edge_cover.description: Minimum edge cover of the network.

powlaw_alpha.name: powlaw_alpha
powlaw_alpha.description: Power law exponent of the degree distribution in the network.

powlaw_k.name: powlaw_k
powlaw_k.description: K parameter of the power law fit to the degree distribution in the network.

powlaw_rsq.name: powlaw_rsq
powlaw_rsq.description: R-squared value of the power law fit to the degree distribution in the network.

preferential_attachment.name: preferential_attachment
preferential_attachment.description: Preferential attachment coefficient of the network. Reference: https://networkx.org/documentation/stable/reference/algorithms/generated/networkx.algorithms.preferential_attachment.html

resource_allocation_index.name: resource_allocation_index
resource_allocation_index.description: Resource allocation index of nodes in the network. Reference: https://networkx.org/documentation/stable/reference/algorithms/generated/networkx.algorithms.similarity.resource_allocation_index.html

shortest_path_length.name: shortest_path_length
shortest_path_length.description: Shortest path length in the network.
